cases.description: A file that mixes CRLF and LF reads every line break as \n.
A lone CR is a line ending (CommonMark 0.31.2, 2.1), so a file with CR line endings reads every line break as \n.
Setext underlines followed by CRLF make headings as with LF (CommonMark 0.31.2, 2.1 and 4.3), and the last body ends without a final newline.

With CR line endings throughout, the front matter delimiters are found, its block scalar keeps its lines joined by \n, and its multi-line plain scalar folds to one line (§5.1). The yaml package does not read a lone CR as a line break, so a reader based on it must convert first.
